name: mdrestyler
summary: Measure prose against an author voice profile, guard against copying, and restyle a Markdown book toward it. The measures locate drift; a reading decides.
author: Taras Baranyuk

languages.other: language-neutral measures only; no word segmenter for Han, kana, Thai, Lao, Khmer or Myanmar

skills.name: mdrestyler
skills.purpose: Build or install a voice profile, check a draft's voice or copying, choose between takes by reading, and restyle chapters or a book with the need-first procedure.

install.agent_skill: Copy skills/mdrestyler/ into the agent's skills folder and run python3 scripts/mdrestyler.py from inside it; nothing needs installing.
install.github_actions:
- uses: sagol/mdrestyler@v0.1.1
  with:
    command: check
    args: --profile voice chapters/01.md --strict

command.description: The mdrestyler command to run, such as check, rank, book, verify or profile.

args.description: The command's arguments as one string, split like a shell would.

working-directory.description: The folder to run in; paths in args are relative to it.

scan.syntax: mdrestyler scan [--own EPUB] [--reference EPUB] [--own-book BOOK] [--eligibility FILE] --out OUT --work WORK [--min-words N] [--replace] [--max-expanded-mb N]
scan.description: Build a voice profile, one per language with enough text, from DRM-free EPUBs (--own, --reference, each repeatable) or from the author's own Markdown book (--own-book with --eligibility). Writes the profile to --out and sample passages to --work.
inputs: or a Markdown book folder and an eligibility JSON file
outputs: JSON report on stdout with profiles and skipped

exit_codes.1: Refused (DRM, a size limit, an existing profile, a folder inside a book, a destination that is a symbolic link, the same book given twice) or no language had enough text.
exit_codes.2: Error, such as a damaged archive, an input that is not a regular file or a language tag that names no language.

check.syntax: mdrestyler check --profile FOLDER CANDIDATE.md [MORE.md ...] [--lang LANG] [--json] [--strict] [--accepted BASE]
check.description: Measure drafts against a profile and run the copy guard. Reports the profile status, copy-guard runs, each measure against its range, the voice distance, and narration and dialogue apart. --accepted checks a revision of one unit against its exact accepted base.

exit_codes.1: The copy guard found a run, or with --strict a measure is outside its range and not marked weak, or could not be compared with a profile scanned by another measure method.
exit_codes.2: Error, including a profile or guard that is not valid.

rank.syntax: mdrestyler rank --profile FOLDER TAKE1.md TAKE2.md [TAKE3.md ...] [--lang LANG] [--json]
rank.description: Order two or more takes of one unit, each checked alone: takes with a copy-guard run last, then by narration distance, voice distance and the number of measures outside. The order informs a reading and chooses nothing.

exit_codes.0: Ranking printed; a ranking informs and does not gate.

book.syntax: mdrestyler book BOOK --profile FOLDER --list UNITS [--within p90] [--lang LANG] [--json]
book.description: Check every unit a --list file names, in reading order, one row each, with a restyle reading of each unit's narration distance against a threshold (p50, p90 default, max, or a number): beyond, within or by reading. The column orders a reading; it decides nothing.

exit_codes.2: The table stopped: a unit outside the book, missing, named twice or not Markdown, or an invalid profile.

install.description: Install a profile into a profile folder. Without SOURCE, the shipped default for the language. A draft or approved profile already there is replaced only with --replace, and its files move to history/<time>/ first. Prints JSON with language, installed, status and kept.

exit_codes.1: Not installed, for example a profile already there and no --replace.

profile validate.description: Report a profile folder's status (approved, draft or default) and revision as JSON, or why it is not valid.

verify.description: Check the skill folder the command runs from against MANIFEST.json, and the manifest digest with --expect. Prints JSON with root, manifest_sha256 and ok.

exit_codes.1: A file is missing, changed or unlisted, or the digest differs from --expect.
exit_codes.2: Not run from a skill folder.

--version.description: Print the version, the source commit and the manifest digest.

profile_files.AUTHOR_PROFILE.<lang>.md: The described voice and a table of the measured targets; status default, draft or approved.
profile_files.author-profile.<lang>.json: Measures, target ranges, function-word fingerprint, calibration, and narration and dialogue ranges, with each source's hash.
profile_files.copy-guard.<lang>.json: Winnowed hashes of the scanned books' 8-word runs, no text.
profile_files.history/<time>/: Earlier profiles, kept when one is replaced.

rules: The measures locate drift; a reading decides. Never pick a take, accept a change or rewrite a sentence by the number alone.
Read the narration distance during a restyle; the pooled distance also weighs the share of dialogue.
Only the author's own books may be quoted in a profile. A reference book's text never enters a profile, a draft or a book.
Candidate text never changes a profile, and generated text is never evidence of the author's voice.
A copy-guard hit blocks a candidate. If the check cannot run, the candidate stays unfinished.
Write three takes per restyled unit, choose one whole take by reading, never splice takes, and promote only after recorded acceptance.

example.name: cross-restyle
example.description: A passage of Adventures of Huckleberry Finn restyled toward The Turn of the Screw and back, with profiles, takes, choices and measures before and after.
